name: Smashed Potatoes With Bacon & Eggs
dish: Plates of greens topped with a crisp oven-smashed baked potato, two eggs fried in bacon fat, bacon crumbles, spicy sour cream and scallions. Serves 4, any time of day.

ingredients: large russet potatoes, scrubbed and pricked with a fork

stages.do: flatten each potato on the tray with a flat pan lid
oil over, salt, pepper; back in oven; then leave in oven to stay warm
ingredients: olive oil, plus more as needed
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

stages.do: sauce: whisk sour cream + hot sauce, loosen with water; season
ingredients: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

stages.do: tip fat into heatproof cup, keep 3 tbsp in pan
eggs fried a few at a time, spooning hot fat on top; season; add saved fat or olive oil between batches if pan is dry
ingredients: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

stages.do: plate: greens, 1 potato, 2 eggs, crumbled bacon, sauce drizzle, scallions
ingredients: crunchy lettuce or tender greens (e.g., arugula, spinach)
scallions, thinly sliced on the bias

splits.ingredient: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

notes: Hot sauce optional. All 3 tbsp olive oil go on potatoes; "more as needed" is unmeasured (assumed use: egg frying if lean/vegetarian bacon gives little fat). Egg yolk doneness not stated. Potatoes hot when smashed: protect hand.
